messages.skill.engineer-traps-corridor-1.name: Demolition Corridor
messages.skill.engineer-traps-corridor-1.descript: SS+ capstone: remote-fire two ready owned plates within 360 pixels on a clear 26-pixel-radius strip. Both actual explosions must deliver, then a further visible 0.4-second commitment releases 300 base damage along their fixed connection. Ground obstruction, expiry or owner loss cancels the strip. Clear paired commitment uses a 16-second cooldown; ordinary remote firing remains 12 seconds. Uses the run’s single capstone choice.
messages.pathway.engineer-traps-corridor-1.summar: SS+ capstone: remote-fire two ready owned plates within 360 pixels on a clear 26-pixel-radius strip. Both actual explosions must deliver, then a further visible 0.4-second commitment releases 300 base damage along their fixed connection. Ground obstruction, expiry or owner loss cancels the strip. Clear paired commitment uses a 16-second cooldown; ordinary remote firing remains 12 seconds. Uses the run’s single capstone choice.
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-1.name: Builder
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-1.summary: Q assembles a 100-base-health screen 120 pixels ahead instead of Rivet Turret. Its 220-pixel frontage takes 0.5 seconds to brace before it blocks hostile shots. It lasts 30 seconds; friendly movement stays clear. One owned Q group at a time. Blocked ground, lava, map edges or full capacity spend no cooldown. Q keeps its 18-second base recovery. Barricade and Impossible Machine retain their roles.
messages.ui.pathwayRouteHelp: Compare all three Q identities, or open one route for a closer view. Inspection spends nothing; choosing an entry commits this run.
messages.skill.engineer-builder-1.name: Field Screen
messages.skill.engineer-builder-1.description: Q assembles a 100-base-health screen 120 pixels ahead instead of Rivet Turret. Its 220-pixel frontage takes 0.5 seconds to brace before it blocks hostile shots. It lasts 30 seconds; friendly movement stays clear. One owned Q group at a time. Blocked ground, lava, map edges or full capacity spend no cooldown. Q keeps its 18-second base recovery. Barricade and Impossible Machine retain their roles.
messages.skill.engineer-builder-longspan-1.name: Longspan Panels
messages.skill.engineer-builder-longspan-1.descri: The Q screen spans 380 pixels instead of 220, with the same total health. More frontage means more incoming fire can wear it down. Excludes Return Wings.
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-longspan-1.summ: The Q screen spans 380 pixels instead of 220, with the same total health. More frontage means more incoming fire can wear it down. Excludes Return Wings.
messages.skill.engineer-builder-wings-1.name: Return Wings
messages.skill.engineer-builder-wings-1.descripti: Replace the front screen with two angled 150-pixel side panels, sharing the original 100-base-health budget. They protect the flanks and leave the central approach exposed. The pair counts as one Q group. Excludes Longspan Panels.
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-wings-1.summary: Replace the front screen with two angled 150-pixel side panels, sharing the original 100-base-health budget. They protect the flanks and leave the central approach exposed. The pair counts as one Q group. Excludes Longspan Panels.
messages.skill.engineer-builder-hinge-1.name: Hinged Assembly
messages.skill.engineer-builder-hinge-1.descripti: Adds action 1 (default C; remappable). Fold a nearby Q group and pivot it to your fixed aimed heading over 0.5 seconds. Folded panels do not stop bullets. Reach 320 pixels; base cooldown 6 seconds. The whole rotation must clear cover, lava and map edges. Health and original expiry stay unchanged.
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-hinge-1.summary: Adds action 1 (default C; remappable). Fold a nearby Q group and pivot it to your fixed aimed heading over 0.5 seconds. Folded panels do not stop bullets. Reach 320 pixels; base cooldown 6 seconds. The whole rotation must clear cover, lava and map edges. Health and original expiry stay unchanged.
messages.skill.engineer-builder-repair-1.name: Field Maintenance
messages.skill.engineer-builder-repair-1.descript: Adds action 2 (default B; remappable). Remain within 8 pixels of your starting point for 0.8 seconds to restore up to 45 base health to the nearest damaged owned wall within 180 pixels. Movement, folding, cover, owner loss or destruction interrupts the work. Base cooldown 16 seconds. No resurrection, lifetime extension, player healing or shield gain.
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-repair-1.summar: Adds action 2 (default B; remappable). Remain within 8 pixels of your starting point for 0.8 seconds to restore up to 45 base health to the nearest damaged owned wall within 180 pixels. Movement, folding, cover, owner loss or destruction interrupts the work. Base cooldown 16 seconds. No resurrection, lifetime extension, player healing or shield gain.
messages.skill.engineer-builder-linked-1.name: Linked Foundations
messages.skill.engineer-builder-linked-1.descript: Maintain two separate Q screen groups. Each keeps its own construction delay, health and original 30-second lifetime. Existing Barricade and redoubt panels use their own limits. No extra turret purchase is needed.
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-linked-1.summar: Maintain two separate Q screen groups. Each keeps its own construction delay, health and original 30-second lifetime. Existing Barricade and redoubt panels use their own limits. No extra turret purchase is needed.
messages.skill.engineer-builder-survey-1.name: Survey Frame
messages.skill.engineer-builder-survey-1.descript: Evolve action 1: fold, pivot and shift a nearby Q group up to 120 pixels toward a fixed point 120 pixels ahead of your aim, then rebrace. The whole path must be clear. Construction takes 0.8 seconds; base cooldown 8 seconds. No protection while folded, no health reset and no lifetime extension.
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-survey-1.summar: Evolve action 1: fold, pivot and shift a nearby Q group up to 120 pixels toward a fixed point 120 pixels ahead of your aim, then rebrace. The whole path must be clear. Construction takes 0.8 seconds; base cooldown 8 seconds. No protection while folded, no health reset and no lifetime extension.
messages.skill.engineer-builder-redoubt-1.name: Keystone Redoubt
messages.skill.engineer-builder-redoubt-1.descrip: SS+ capstone: your ultimate still deploys Impossible Machine with its issued health, fire, duration and optional mobility. On clear ground it also assembles three 90-base-health panels around that initial position over 0.8 seconds. They last at most 12 seconds and disappear if the linked machine or owner is lost. The opening stays accessible and teammates can pass through. A moving machine leaves its fortification behind. Blocked fortification ground preserves the machine without adding panels. Uses the run’s single capstone.
messages.pathway.engineer-builder-redoubt-1.summa: SS+ capstone: your ultimate still deploys Impossible Machine with its issued health, fire, duration and optional mobility. On clear ground it also assembles three 90-base-health panels around that initial position over 0.8 seconds. They last at most 12 seconds and disappear if the linked machine or owner is lost. The opening stays accessible and teammates can pass through. A moving machine leaves its fortification behind. Blocked fortification ground preserves the machine without adding panels. Uses the run’s single capstone.
messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-1.name: Skirmisher
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-1.name: Passing Shot
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-advance-1.name: Crossing Advance
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-rear-1.name: Rear Guard
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-1.description: After Precision Burst, use action 1 within 1.2 seconds while holding movement. Commit a legal 90-pixel step over 0.3 seconds, then fire one 15-base-damage piercing round along the aim you committed. The original burst, rally and ultimate remain. One follow-up per burst; 6-second base recovery. No dodge immunity or free ammunition. Obstruction, hostile slow/displacement, dodge or owner loss cancels unfinished work without a refund.
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-advance-1.descr: Passing Shot becomes a committed forward crossing along your starting aim. Its same follow-up damage is split equally between a departure round and an arrival round. Aim again for the arrival shot while your route stays fixed. No extra total follow-up damage, terrain bypass or immunity. Excludes Rear Guard.
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-rear-1.descript: Passing Shot becomes a committed backward step from your starting aim. Fire the same follow-up damage halfway through and intercept at most one visible hostile projectile in a 96-pixel forward lane with 12-pixel clearance. Other projectiles, contact, fixed warnings and hazards remain dangerous. Cover blocks interception. Excludes Crossing Advance.
messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-1.summary: Burst, choose a legal step, then fire on arrival. Keep the ordinary burst and rally.
messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-advance-1.sum: Commit forward; fire on departure, then aim the arrival round again.
messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-rear-1.summar: Commit backward; a timed guard shot can intercept one visible projectile.
messages.ui.soldier.manualHelp: Choose a firing discipline and inspect its controls, costs and commitments. Your rally, Precision Burst and Last Roll Call remain part of every build.
messages.ui.soldier.kitHelp: Your issued rally, Precision Burst and Last Roll Call remain. A firing discipline adds its own action. Inspect its General foundation and exclusions before buying.
messages.ui.soldier.passingHelp: After Precision Burst, hold a movement direction and use action 1 within 1.2 seconds. The committed step fires on arrival. It grants no dodge immunity.
messages.ui.soldier.advanceHelp: After Precision Burst, use action 1 within 1.2 seconds to commit forward along your aim. Fire on departure, then aim the arrival round again. The route stays fixed.
messages.ui.soldier.rearHelp: After Precision Burst, use action 1 within 1.2 seconds to commit backward from your aim. The halfway guard shot can intercept one visible projectile; it does not make you invulnerable.
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-drill-1.name: Cartridge Drill
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-roving-1.name: Roving Chamber
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-drill-1.descrip: Earn action 2: load up to four missing rounds, one at a time, while walking. The first takes 35% of your weapon's current full-reload time; later rounds take 20% each. Primary fire waits. Use action 2 again to stop and keep completed rounds. Fresh Precision Burst, a committed Passing Shot, dodge, ordinary Reload or health damage interrupts. Replacing an ordinary reload forfeits its unfinished work. 12-second base recovery. Ordinary Reload still fills the whole magazine.
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-roving-1.descri: Cartridge Drill can continue through fresh Precision Burst and Passing Shot, including either early fork. Coordinate loading, burst and a committed step without waiting for all four rounds. The same finite round count, timing and recovery remain. Dodge, ordinary Reload and health damage still interrupt. No extra ammunition beyond magazine capacity, immunity or cooldown refund.
messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-drill-1.summa: Take a few rounds early; stop loading when you have enough to fire.
messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-roving-1.summ: Keep hand-loading while you burst and commit a step.
messages.ui.soldier.drillHelp: Action 2 loads at most four missing rounds. Use it again to stop and keep completed rounds; held primary fire then resumes. Ordinary Reload fills the whole magazine. Fresh burst/committed step, dodge, ordinary Reload and health damage stop this drill.
messages.ui.soldier.rovingHelp: Your finite drill can continue through burst and a committed step. Use action 2 again to stop and keep completed rounds. Dodge, ordinary Reload and health damage still stop it. Ordinary Reload keeps its full-magazine role.
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-ready-1.name: Ready Round
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-volley-1.name: Running Volley
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-ready-1.descrip: The first actual Cartridge Drill insertion opens 1.2 seconds for a paid Passing Shot. Spend one magazine round to use your owned step variant without a burst opening. Its normal recovery still applies. A ready Precision Burst follow-up takes priority and stays free. Invalid ground spends nothing. Dodge, ordinary Reload, health damage and owner or weapon loss clear the loaded opening. Starting a reload or receiving a refill does not create one.
messages.skill.soldier-skirmisher-volley-1.descri: A loaded step opening can be spent during Passing Shot recovery. Once per drill, finish the first paid step and actually insert at least three rounds to earn a 0.8-second second paid step; either event can happen first. Each commitment costs one real magazine round and keeps the owned step variant. An interrupted first step earns no relay. Recovery extends from each commitment, with no refund. At most two paid steps per drill; no extra rounds, immunity or new input. Counts as your one capstone.
messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-ready-1.summa: Use one completed loading round to open a step while your burst is reserved.
messages.pathway.soldier-skirmisher-volley-1.summ: Finish a paid step and load three rounds to earn a brief second leg.
messages.ui.soldier.readyHelp: After the first real drill insertion, action 1 has a 1.2-second loaded opening. Spend one magazine round for the owned step when no ready burst follow-up is available; normal step recovery still applies. Stopping the drill keeps that short earned opening. Dodge, ordinary Reload and health damage clear it.
messages.ui.soldier.volleyHelp: Loaded openings may be spent during step recovery. Once per drill, finishing the first paid step and inserting three actual rounds earns a 0.8-second relay. The relay spends one more magazine round. Stopping early cannot manufacture the third insertion; a canceled first step earns no relay. Both paid steps keep the owned variant and extend its recovery.
messages.pathway.soldier-marksman-1.name: Marksman
messages.pathway.soldier-marksman-1.summary: Read the cover, choose an angle and spend a cartridge on one deliberate bank.
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-1.name: Bank Shot
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-1.description: Use action 1 to spend one magazine round on a 30-base-damage shot that reflects from one masonry face or closed gate. Read the angle: real bodies can stop the first leg and a further wall stops the bank. The projectile travels at 900 pixels per second for at most 1.6 seconds, with 8-second base recovery. No burst opening is needed. Ordinary Reload, dodge or channeling prevents a fresh shot. No auto-aim, immunity, free ammunition or boss-core bypass. Choose this firing discipline instead of Skirmisher; your issued rally, burst and Last Roll Call remain.
messages.ui.soldier.marksmanHelp: Bank Shot spends one magazine round on action 1. Aim into a masonry face to reflect once, or take a direct shot. Plan around real bodies and further cover. Ordinary Reload and dodge prevent a fresh cast; a rejected request spends no round or recovery. The shot adds no movement or immunity. Your rally, burst and Last Roll Call keep their own jobs.
messages.ui.soldier.pairHelp: Measured Pair uses action 2. Spend one round now; its first real cover bank earns 1.2 seconds for one manually aimed second press, spending another round. The second cannot earn another shot or refresh the window. Reload, dodge and channeling block a fresh shot without spending; missed or expired opportunities never refund the first round or recovery.
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-carom-1.name: Double Bank
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-carom-1.descripti: Carry Bank Shot through a second real masonry contact. Its original lifetime and travel budget stay finite; a third wall absorbs it. Choose this instead of Line Drive.
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-line-1.name: Line Drive
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-line-1.descriptio: After its first real bank, the shot can pass through one ordinary hostile body. Bosses, weak points and further cover still stop it. Bodies before the bank still intercept. Choose this instead of Double Bank.
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-pair-1.name: Measured Pair
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-pair-1.descriptio: Action 2 spends one actual round on a bank shot and starts twelve seconds of recovery. Its first real cover contact earns 1.2 seconds to manually aim and spend one further round with action 2. At most two shots; the second cannot earn another. Both inherit your chosen bank variant.
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-reserve-1.name: Held Measure
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-reserve-1.descrip: After Measured Pair earns its second shot, begin one real manual Reload to keep that opportunity through the reload and 0.6 seconds afterward, at most four seconds total. It cannot be reserved twice. Dodge, channel, overdrive, weapon or technique loss cancels the reserved opportunity. The normal reload still takes its full time; no extra rounds are created.
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-relay-1.name: Angle Relay
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-relay-1.descripti: Only the second paid Measured Pair shot's first real cover bank earns 0.8 seconds for one paid Bank Shot during its recovery. Spend one real round and extend, rather than reset, the existing Bank Shot recovery. An ordinary ready shot consumes the same opportunity. No automatic shot or recursive proof.
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-twin-1.name: Twin Lanes
messages.skill.soldier-marksman-twin-1.descriptio: When using an earned Angle Relay during Bank Shot recovery, spend two actual rounds to fire two physical bank shots ten degrees to either side of your manual aim. Both inherit your chosen bank variant and use real cover, bodies, travel and armor. Both projectile slots must fit or nothing is spent. One release consumes the relay and extends recovery; neither shot earns another opportunity. Ordinary ready Bank Shot remains one round.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-1.name: Grenadier
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-1.summary: Cooked Canister: Prepare, cook and manually throw one finite canister.
messages.ui.grenadier.help: Action 1 prepares a single live canister; press again to throw. A held primary trigger stays blocked; release and press it again to cancel the live hand. Fuse time keeps running while you cook and throw. Holding to expiry safely vents it; the spent recovery remains. Action 2 later adds short casts and grounded handling. Your rally, burst and Last Roll Call keep their own effects.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-1.name: Cooked Canister
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-1.description: Press action 1 to prepare one canister and start ten-second base recovery. Press again to throw along your manual aim. Its 2.4-second fuse keeps running while held or moving; holding to expiry safely vents the canister and spends the recovery. A normal cast starts at 650 pixels/second, slows on the floor, and stops at bodies or cover before its 90-pixel, 80-base-damage blast. Cover and source-sensitive armor apply. A live hand blocks primary fire until you throw or cancel; firing, Reload, dodge, actual health loss, burst or overdrive interrupts it. No friendly damage, ammunition refill or extra resource. Choose this discipline instead of Skirmisher or Marksman.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-skim-1.name: Skimming Case
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-skim-1.descripti: The thrown canister banks once from real fixed cover, retaining the unused portion of that tick and eighty percent of its speed. A further wall or a body grounds it; the same finite fuse continues. Excludes Contact Case.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-skim-1.summary: Skimming Case: One real bank, same fuse.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-contact-1.name: Contact Case
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-contact-1.descri: A thrown canister bursts on its first physical body or cover contact instead of waiting on the floor. It cannot bank, seek a target or pass cover. Manual cooking still sets how long it can travel before the fuse expires. Excludes Skimming Case.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-contact-1.summ: Contact Case: Burst at physical contact.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-pitch-1.name: Underhand Cast
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-pitch-1.descript: Action 2 makes a short cast at 280 pixels/second. It can release the canister already in your hand, or prepare and cast a fresh one in a single press if the same recovery is ready. Floor drag, bodies, cover and the actual remaining fuse still apply; no second stock or recovery is created.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-pitch-1.summar: Underhand Cast: A shorter throw on the same recovery.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-pin-1.name: Re-pin Drill
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-pin-1.descriptio: One Reload press may re-pin a live hand canister for at most four seconds, freeing the hand. The remaining fuse is stored exactly, never rewound. Action 1 resumes that same canister; it may not be re-pinned twice, including after a later catch. Ordinary magazine reload is separate. Excludes Clipped Sling; this preparation choice is optional before Toe Roll.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-pin-1.summary: Re-pin Drill: One bounded stored fuse.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-sling-1.name: Clipped Sling
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-sling-1.descript: Keep the live hand canister while using your issued Precision Burst and its owned General transformations. Its fuse keeps running; this grants no burst damage, free ammo or recovery. Primary fire, ordinary Reload, dodge, health loss and overdrive still interrupt it. Excludes Re-pin Drill; this offensive timing choice is optional before Toe Roll.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-sling-1.summar: Clipped Sling: Keep cooking through your issued burst.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-kick-1.name: Toe Roll
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-kick-1.descripti: Action 2 near your own grounded canister kicks that actual object along manual aim at 420 pixels/second. You must be within 48 pixels with a clear path. One kick per canister; its remaining fuse, casing choice and spent recovery stay exact. A nearby eligible grounded canister takes priority over a fresh short cast. No teleport, new charge, targeting or fuse refresh.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-kick-1.summary: Toe Roll: Approach and kick your actual grounded canister.
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-return-1.name: Live Return
messages.skill.soldier-grenadier-return-1.descrip: Action 1 can catch your own grounded canister within 48 clear pixels when at least 0.2 seconds of fuse remains. It returns the same object to your hand for another manually aimed throw. One catch per canister; its remaining fuse, spent kick/re-pin rights, casing and recovery are retained. Pool rejection cannot eat the held charge. No new explosive, stock or rewound clock.
messages.pathway.soldier-grenadier-return-1.summa: Live Return: Catch the same object once; no clock reset.
messages.pathway.soldier-sniper-1.name: Sniper
messages.pathway.soldier-sniper-1.summary: Settled Shot: Plant, settle and deliberately release one actual round.
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-1.name: Settled Shot
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-1.description: Action 1 reserves one actual magazine round and starts ten-second base recovery. Stand still for 0.7 seconds, then press action 1 again to fire a manually aimed, direct 110-base-damage physical shot. Preparation lasts at most three seconds and never fires automatically. Turning more than twelve degrees from the settled bearing recenters the sight and restarts settling within the original deadline. Movement, a new primary press, Reload, dodge, health loss, burst or overdrive cancels the paid preparation without refund. A held primary stays blocked through preparation; release and press it again to cancel. Let an already committed burst finish before preparing. Cover, bodies, travel and source armor apply; no bank, piercing, targeting or immunity. Choose this discipline instead of Skirmisher, Marksman or Grenadier.
messages.ui.sniper.help: Action 1 reserves one actual round and starts recovery. Stand still while the sight settles, then press again when you choose to fire. Turning more than twelve degrees from the settled bearing recenters the sight and restarts settling within the original three-second preparation. Movement, Reload, dodge, health loss, burst or overdrive abandons the paid round. A held primary stays blocked; release and press it again to cancel. Let an already committed burst finish before preparing. Your rally, burst and Last Roll Call keep their own effects.
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-carry-1.name: Careful Carry
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-carry-1.description: Movement can carry the same paid Settled Shot round within its original three-second preparation. Every actual displacement moves the sight to your current position, recenters its bearing and restarts the full0.7-second settle. Stop and settle before separately releasing; there is no moving release, extra speed, protection or deadline extension. Fresh preparation still requires a planted body. Reload, dodge, actual health loss, channel, burst, overdrive or a new primary press after release still abandons the round. Choose this handling instead of Clear Chamber.
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-clear-1.name: Clear Chamber
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-clear-1.description: During valid Settled Shot preparation, press Reload to return exactly its one reserved round into available magazine space. This cancels preparation and keeps the spent recovery; that press clears the chamber rather than starting an ordinary reload. A full magazine rejects the clear and preserves the paid preparation and original deadline. A later Reload without preparation works normally. Firing, expiry, movement or another interruption returns nothing. Choose this handling instead of Careful Carry.
messages.ui.sniper.carryHelp: Action 1 reserves one actual round and starts recovery. With Careful Carry you can relocate the paid round, but every actual movement recenters the sight and restarts the full0.7-second settle. Stop and settle before manual release; the original three-second deadline never extends. Aim beyond twelve degrees also recenters. Reload, dodge, actual health loss, channel, burst, overdrive or a new primary press after release abandons the round. A held primary stays blocked. Your rally, burst and Last Roll Call keep their own effects.
messages.ui.sniper.clearHelp: Action 1 reserves one actual round and starts recovery. Stand still, settle and separately press again to fire; aim beyond twelve degrees recenters within the original three-second deadline. With Clear Chamber, Reload returns exactly the reserved round into available magazine space, cancels preparation and keeps recovery. That press clears rather than ordinarily reloads; a full magazine rejects the clear while preserving preparation/deadline. A later Reload works normally. Movement, dodge, actual health loss, channel, burst, overdrive or a new primary press after release still abandons the round. A held primary stays blocked. Your rally, burst and Last Roll Call keep their own effects.
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-bore-1.name: Bore Through
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-bore-1.description: After preparing and settling Settled Shot, action 2 releases the same paid round with70base ability impact instead of110. It may cross one narrow cover section, at most68pixels along its actual path including the round's width, then retains sixty percent impact. Travel inside cover consumes real time and lifespan; deeper masonry, another solid or the first body stops it. Armor uses your actual firing origin. This is no body piercing, bank, targeting or armor bypass. It cannot prepare a fresh round, extend the original opportunity, return ammunition or reset recovery. Action 1 keeps its direct shot. Careful Carry and Clear Chamber remain optional handling choices.
messages.ui.sniper.boreHelp: Bore Through uses action 2 to release the already settled round through one narrow cover section at reduced impact. Prepare with action 1 first. Real travel continues inside cover; deeper masonry, another solid and the first body stop the shot. Action 1 retains its direct shot, and the original preparation deadline/recovery still apply.
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-rest-1.name: Field Rest
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-rest-1.description: With no paid round prepared, action2 sets an empty rest at your actual position and bearing. Remain planted for0.7seconds; moving, taking health loss or another action interrupts unfinished setup. Once settled you may leave, but the rest stays fixed and expires9seconds after planting. Return within6pixels and12degrees: an accepted fresh action1 consumes the rest and reserves one actual round ready for a separate manual release. Normal recovery and actual ammunition still apply; unavailable preparation preserves the rest. Elsewhere action1 retains its ordinary full settling. Action2 recalls an existing empty rest, or uses Bore Through when a paid round is prepared. Carry movement restarts settling; Clear returns only the paid round, never the rest. No automatic shot, targeting, remote origin, cover, protection, extra ammunition or new currency.
messages.ui.sniper.restHelp: With no paid preparation, action2 sets an empty Field Rest or recalls an existing one. Stand still and settle it for0.7s; it stays fixed for9s from planting. You may then leave and return within6px/12degrees. A fresh accepted action1 consumes the rest and pays for one round ready for a separate manual release; recovery and actual ammunition still apply. If preparation is unavailable, the rest stays. Elsewhere action1 settles normally. With a paid preparation, action2 remains Bore Through. Carry movement restarts settling; Clear never restores the rest.
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-withdrawal-1.name: Prepared Withdrawal
messages.skill.soldier-sniper-withdrawal-1.descri: Prepare two separate Field Rest positions at least96pixels apart, each with its real settling, manual bearing and original expiry. Both must be settled before a normally available action1 claims the first. Only a successful separate manual release earns one return opportunity at the other original site. Physically return within its local position/bearing limits: action1 may reserve another actual round during recovery, ready for its own separate manual release. That alternate payment extends spent recovery by one ordinary action1 duration. A normally ready claim consumes the same finite opportunity. With no paid preparation, action2 sets a second site only after the first settles and from sufficient distance; nearer action2, two sites or an armed return means recall the plan. Carry still requires new settling after movement; Clear returns only its reserved round and keeps recovery. No site, right or ammunition is restored and a return cannot earn another return. Physical bodies, cover, time and firing-origin armor remain.
messages.ui.sniper.withdrawalBoreName: Field Rest / Prepared Withdrawal / Bore Through
messages.ui.sniper.withdrawalHelp: Settle both positions before the first normally available action1 claim. That round must actually be released before one return can be paid for at the other original site during recovery. Recovery extends; the original site expiry keeps running. With no paid preparation, action2 sets a second site only after the first settles and from at least96px away; nearer action2, two sites or an armed return means recall. Carry and Clear retain their issued handling.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-1.name: Flak Gunner
messages.ui.heavy.manualHelp: Choose a defensive flak round or a paid firing stroke. Ordinary gunfire, Braced Firing and Suppressing Cone keep their own roles.
messages.ui.heavy.flakHelp: Action 1 spends one magazine round to launch a defensive flak shell. It clears at most three small hostile shots only when it bursts, with cover blocking. It deals no body damage and cannot clear large objects, beams, fields or ground attacks. Moving and bracing are allowed; busy or empty rejection spends nothing.
messages.ui.heavy.commandHelp: Action 2 commands your one actual flying shell before its original fuse ends. It cannot act on the launch moment, add another shell or reset recovery. The burst uses nearby shots after they move.
messages.skill.heavy-flak-1.name: Flak Round
messages.skill.heavy-flak-1.description: Spend one magazine round to launch a defensive flak shell along your manual aim. Its 0.6-second fuse or first body/cover contact makes one burst at its actual position. After nearby shots move, the 45-pixel burst clears at most three small hostile projectiles with clear line of sight. It deals no body damage and cannot clear large objects, beams, fields or ground attacks. Protection begins only at the burst; earlier hits remain. Moving and Braced Firing are allowed. Reloading, dodging, channeling, overdrive, empty ammunition or a full projectile pool rejects launch without payment. Ordinary primary pauses for the launch. Base recovery is eight seconds.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-1.summary: Place one delayed defensive burst with an actual magazine round.
messages.skill.heavy-flak-compact-1.name: Close Pattern
messages.skill.heavy-flak-compact-1.description: Fit a shorter 0.4-second fuse and a 60-pixel all-around burst. It reaches less distant ground before bursting, but covers every bearing. One magazine round, at most three small hostile shots and the same recovery; real bodies and cover still stop the shell. Choose this fitting instead of Forward Baffle.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-compact-1.summary: A shorter flight and wider all-around burst.
messages.skill.heavy-flak-frontal-1.name: Forward Baffle
messages.skill.heavy-flak-frontal-1.description: Fit a longer 0.8-second fuse and a 90-pixel forward burst within a 70-degree fan. The fan keeps the original firing bearing and leaves a real rear gap. One magazine round, at most three small hostile shots and the same recovery; real bodies and cover still stop the shell. Choose this fitting instead of Close Pattern.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-frontal-1.summary: Reach farther forward with a real rear gap.
messages.skill.heavy-flak-command-1.name: Manual Fuze
messages.skill.heavy-flak-command-1.description: Use action 2 to burst your one actual flying flak shell at its present position. Command it before the original fuse ends; the burst still waits until nearby shots have moved. It cannot act on the launch moment, create another shell or burst, return ammunition or reset recovery. Busy hands reject the command while the original flight and fuse continue. Without a live own shell there is no action to command. Both optional burst fittings retain their actual geometry.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-command-1.summary: Choose when the one actual flying shell bursts.
messages.skill.heavy-flak-running-1.name: Running Fuze
messages.skill.heavy-flak-running-1.description: Change your first Action 2 command into one early interception pulse while the same paid shell keeps flying. That pulse may clear at most one actual small hostile shot. The original fuse or first body/cover contact later makes the final pulse, using only the unspent part of the original combined three-shot allowance. An empty early pulse uses no interception allowance, but the command is still spent. You cannot command that shell again. No new round, extra carrier, extended fuse or recovery reset. Choose this handling instead of Hanging Fuze; omitting both keeps the original immediate three-shot Manual Fuze.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-running-1.summary: One early interception, then the same shell carries the unspent allowance onward.
messages.skill.heavy-flak-hanging-1.name: Hanging Fuze
messages.skill.heavy-flak-hanging-1.description: Your first Action 2 command arrests the actual shell at its current air position and firing bearing. It does not burst on that command or extend its original fuse. A separate later Action 2 can burst the same shell there; its original fuse or an actual enemy body contact can still end it. The one burst retains the original three-small-shot allowance and real cover. Busy rejection keeps the arrested shell and original deadline. No teleport, attachment, extra round, persistent mine, refund or recovery reset. Choose this handling instead of Running Fuze; omitting both keeps the original immediate Manual Fuze.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-hanging-1.summary: Arrest the actual shell, then choose a separate burst before its original fuse.
messages.skill.heavy-flak-seam-1.name: Seam Fuze
messages.skill.heavy-flak-seam-1.description: While your paid flak shell is still live, press Action 1 again to cut its flight and clear a thin seam along the ground it actually crossed. The seam reaches 9 pixels to either side and uses only the unspent part of that shell’s original three-small-shot allowance. Action 2 keeps your acquired point-burst operation, so choose a narrow line behind the shell or a wider burst at it. Running Fuze spends from the same allowance; Hanging Fuze retains only the line laid before arrest. Real cover crossing that line permanently severs it for this shell, leaving Action 2 and the original fuse available. Cut before the original fuse ends. Busy hands reject without cutting. No extra round, body damage, shield, recovery reset or lingering trap.
messages.pathway.heavy-flak-seam-1.summary: Cut the shell’s travelled line, or keep its wider point burst.
messages.ui.heavy.seamHelp: Action 1 launches the round; a separate Action 1 before its fuse cuts the narrow line already travelled. Action 2 keeps its point operation. New cover can sever the line for this shell. A cut shares the original allowance and adds no ammunition cost. The controls below show your current bindings.
messages.pathway.heavy-traverse-1.name: Siege Gunner
messages.pathway.heavy-traverse-1.summary: Maintain a paid firing stroke; steer, release, or relocate its real muzzle.
messages.pathway.heavy-traverse-spade-1.summary: Hold a steerable stable post without adding recoil; displacement breaks the feed.
messages.pathway.heavy-traverse-floating-1.summar: Walk with a locked world bearing and real recoil.
messages.ui.heavy.traverseHelp: Action 1 starts a four-round stroke, paying for each real round only when it leaves. A separate Action 1 releases the feed without a refund or recovery reset. Ordinary primary waits; reload, dodge, channeling, overdrive, an empty magazine or failed later admission ends unpaid work. Default carriage holds walking and recoils against actual cover; its barrel slews within the first firing sector.
messages.skill.heavy-traverse-1.name: Traverse Stroke
messages.skill.heavy-traverse-1.description: Start a finite four-round firing stroke with Action 1. The first physical round leaves immediately; three later rounds each require and spend their own actual magazine round over the next second. Walking pauses while the barrel slews toward manual aim, within sixty degrees of its first bearing. Every admitted round recoils your body eight pixels over the following four combat steps, with real cover blocking movement. Another separate Action 1 releases the feed and lets you walk; fired rounds and their recoil remain. Reload, dodge, channeling or overdrive stops unpaid future rounds. Empty or full-pool rejection spends nothing; a failed later slot ends the feed. Primary waits through the stroke. Each round deals 45 base weapon-scaled damage through ordinary bodies, cover, time and armor. Eight-second base recovery starts with the first admitted round. Choose Siege Gunner instead of Flak Gunner.
messages.skill.heavy-traverse-spade-1.name: Set Spade
messages.skill.heavy-traverse-spade-1.description: Plant this carriage on stable ground before starting a Traverse Stroke: walking input rejects the start without payment. The stroke adds no recoil and keeps its manual barrel slew, while holding walking input. Any actual external ground displacement breaks the post and ends unpaid future rounds; fired rounds remain. Terrain, moving cover and forced movement still apply. The same four actual rounds, original stroke slots and recovery remain. Choose this fitting instead of Floating Cradle.
messages.skill.heavy-traverse-floating-1.name: Floating Cradle
messages.skill.heavy-traverse-floating-1.descript: Walk normally during a Traverse Stroke and retain each paid round’s actual recoil. Every round keeps the initial world bearing: later mouse aim cannot steer the barrel. Relocate the actual muzzle to find new clear lanes, or release the feed when that bearing becomes useless. This grants no movement bonus, protection or extra round and changes no original stroke slots or recovery. Choose this fitting instead of Set Spade.
messages.pathway.heavy-traverse-clutch-1.summary: Lift once, relocate while slots pass unpaid, then re-engage what remains.
messages.ui.heavy.clutchHelp: Action 2 lifts the active feed once, freeing walking while the original firing slots continue. Slots passed while lifted are lost without spending a round. A separate Action 2 re-engages the remaining slots; primary still waits. Set Spade needs stationary input to replant. Floating keeps its first bearing. Paid recoil remains. Action 1 abandons all unpaid work. The original deadline and recovery never reset.
messages.skill.heavy-traverse-clutch-1.name: Feed Clutch
messages.skill.heavy-traverse-clutch-1.descriptio: After the first paid Traverse round, a separate Action 2 lifts its feed and frees walking immediately. Original firing slots keep passing: each slot crossed while lifted is lost without firing or spending a round. A separate later Action 2 re-engages the remaining original slots. Use one lift and re-engage pair per stroke; neither command adds a round, catches up a missed slot, extends the one-second stroke or resets recovery. Primary still waits while future stroke work remains. Set Spade deliberately lifts its post and requires stationary input to replant at the actual new body point; an already broken post cannot be rescued. Floating Cradle keeps its original world bearing. Paid recoil remains physical while lifted. Action 1 still abandons all unpaid work. Reload, dodge, channeling and overdrive end unpaid work. No fitting is required.
messages.pathway.heavy-traverse-keyed-1.summary: Calibrate while lifted; re-engage at the actual barrel bearing and trade later tracking for a fixed lane.
messages.pathway.heavy-traverse-open-1.summary: Trade future C opportunities for real ordinary primary rounds while the feed is lifted.
messages.ui.heavy.keyedHelp: Action 2 lifts the feed once and frees walking. Manually crank the lifted barrel within its original sector, including Floating. A separate Action 2 keys its actual bearing for the remaining original slots; Q keeps independent aim, but primary still waits. Set Spade needs stationary input to replant. Slots passed while lifted are lost unpaid. Paid recoil stays real; Action 1 abandons unpaid work. The short local marker shows the stored C bearing. No extra round, deadline or recovery reset.
messages.ui.heavy.openHelp: Action 2 lifts the feed once and frees walking. Primary works while lifted: each actual paid round trades the next original C opportunity once, even with several pellets. Capacity or empty rejection trades nothing. A separate Action 2 re-engages only the remaining original times; slots passed while lifted are lost unpaid. Set Spade needs stationary input to replant; Floating keeps its first bearing. Paid recoil stays real, and Action 1 abandons unpaid work. No extra round, deadline or recovery reset.
messages.skill.heavy-traverse-keyed-1.name: Keyed Clutch
messages.skill.heavy-traverse-keyed-1.description: While Feed Clutch is lifted, manually crank the real barrel within its original sector and slew speed, including a Floating Cradle. Your separate re-engagement keys its actual current bearing for every remaining original C slot; later aim cannot steer it. Loose and Set Spade can aim their issued Suppressing Cone elsewhere but give up later barrel tracking. Floating gains this one bounded calibration window before keeping the new world bearing as it walks. Primary still waits throughout retained C work. Lifting still loses slots that pass unpaid; neither command adds a round, snaps the barrel to the cursor, catches up a missed slot or changes deadline/recovery. Choose this handling instead of Open Feed; omitting both keeps the original Clutch handling.
messages.skill.heavy-traverse-open-1.name: Open Feed
messages.skill.heavy-traverse-open-1.description: Ordinary primary can fire while Feed Clutch is lifted. Each actually admitted and paid primary round consumes the earliest remaining original C opportunity once, regardless of its number of pellets. It spends real magazine ammunition at the issued primary cadence; the complete real volley must fit capacity before any payment. Empty, busy or capacity rejection converts no slot. Re-engagement keeps only the unconverted original C times; slots passed while lifted are still lost unpaid. This trades later committed C fire for earlier ordinary fire while walking, without reserving or refunding rounds, adding a C slot, extending the stroke or resetting recovery. A simultaneous Action 1 still cancels all unpaid C work first. Choose this handling instead of Keyed Clutch; omitting both retains primary commitment during the original Clutch.
messages.skill.heavy-traverse-lanyard-1.name: Tethered Traverse
messages.skill.heavy-traverse-lanyard-1.descripti: After lifting and re-engaging the feed, press Action 2 separately again to stake this same gun at its actual muzzle and bearing, with at least two original firing opportunities left. Walk within its 64 px control lead while remaining original rounds still pay and travel from that fixed muzzle. Cover cutting the lead, leaving its reach or interruption ends unpaid work. Action 1 releases the stroke. An admitted Suppressing Cone retrieves the gun before firing from your body. No extra round, resource, deadline, recovery reset or autonomous weapon is added.
messages.pathway.heavy-traverse-lanyard-1.summary: Stake the real gun after re-engaging; move around its fixed lane within a breakable control lead.
messages.ui.heavy.lanyardHelp: Action 1 starts the ordinary finite Traverse Stroke. Action 2 lifts the feed; a separate Action 2 re-engages it. With at least two original firing opportunities left, another separate Action 2 stakes the same gun at its actual muzzle and bearing. Walk within its 64 px control lead. Cover cutting the lead or leaving its reach ends unpaid work. Remaining rounds keep their original times, magazine costs and recovery; primary stays committed. Action 1 releases the stroke. An available Suppressing Cone retrieves the gun before firing from your body; an unavailable ability leaves it posted.
messages.ui.heavy.lanyardLooseHelp: Loose gives up later carried-barrel tracking when posted, gaining room to move around the fixed firing lane. Paid recoil still moves your body.
messages.ui.heavy.lanyardSpadeHelp: Set Spade needs stationary input to replant before the separate staking command. Once posted, your body can leave that point within the lead; the original stable gun keeps its issued handling.
messages.ui.heavy.lanyardFloatingHelp: Floating keeps its stored world bearing when posted. The gun stays at its actual post as your body walks, and paid recoil still applies.
messages.ui.heavy.lanyardPlainHelp: The original lift and re-engagement remain useful; neither optional handling choice is required.
messages.ui.heavy.lanyardKeyedHelp: Keyed still permits bounded cranking while lifted. Re-engagement fixes the calibrated bearing before the separate staking command; later aim does not steer the posted gun.
messages.ui.heavy.lanyardOpenHelp: Open still permits ordinary primary only while lifted, trading one original opportunity per paid round. Re-engaging commits primary again. Staking requires at least two unspent original opportunities.
messages.ui.heavy.lanyardSpent: Too late to stake this stroke
messages.pathway.heavy-linework-1.name: Lineworker
messages.pathway.heavy-linework-1.description: Prepare a real masonry anchor, then commit the feed motor to a finite hauling route while carrying the gun. Choose firing-axis handling or finite cable payout.
messages.skill.heavy-linework-1.name: Anchor Cartridge
messages.skill.heavy-linework-1.description: Action1 spends one magazine round on a real900px/s,radius3 anchor with20flight ticks. Current masonry within600px may hold it; living bodies and temporary constructs stop it without becoming attachments. A later separate Action2 engages or brakes the hauling motor. Action1 releases the line. Bare hauling permits lateral walking but commits primary fire. The carried gun stays with your body; current collision, slows and hazards remain. The line lasts150combat ticks from cast, with8second base recovery from payment. A miss still spends the admitted round. Choose Lineworker instead of Flak or Siege Gunner.
messages.skill.heavy-linework-yoke-1.name: Straight Yoke
messages.skill.heavy-linework-yoke-1.description: While hauling, permit ordinary paid primary and restrict ordinary walking to the current anchor approach axis. Aim every shot yourself. A separate Action2 brakes the motor and restores ordinary steering; another engages within the same remaining line. The original one-round anchor,150tick lifetime,600px maximum and recovery remain. Losing this fitting after using its handling releases dependent work. Choose Straight Yoke instead of Open Sheave.
messages.skill.heavy-linework-sheave-1.name: Open Sheave
messages.skill.heavy-linework-sheave-1.descriptio: While braked, pay out actual clear cable up to its original600px maximum, then use a separate Action2 to haul from the changed approach. Keep lateral walking while hauling and keep primary fire committed. Repeated braking never resets the original150tick lifetime, returns the paid anchor round or resets recovery. Losing this fitting after using payout releases dependent work. Choose Open Sheave instead of Straight Yoke.
messages.ui.heavy.lineworkHelp: Action1 pays one actual magazine round for a physical masonry anchor, or releases existing work. Wait for its actual attachment, then use a separate Action2 to engage or brake. The carried gun and body move together through current collision. No shield, hazard clearing, terrain passage or automatic aim is granted. The original150tick line and8second base recovery start with the paid shot.
messages.ui.heavy.lineworkBareHelp: Bare handling keeps lateral walking while hauling and commits primary fire. Braking cannot manufacture more cable; re-engagement may shorten the captured paid length.
messages.ui.heavy.lineworkYokeHelp: Straight Yoke permits ordinary paid primary while hauling but restricts walking to the current anchor approach axis. Aim manually. Brake to recover lateral steering.
messages.ui.heavy.lineworkSheaveHelp: Open Sheave allows clear payout while braked, within the same600px maximum and original deadline. Hauling keeps lateral walking and commits primary fire.
